title: $100 a month into Apple since 2007 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Apple since 2007.
Today that would be worth about {dca:AAPL:2007-01-03} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Apple price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Apple, starting in 2007.
Back then, Apple was about to launch the iPhone.

clip.text: Apple: about to launch the iPhone

scenes.say: Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:AAPL:2007-01-03}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
